gpu.nativeFolder.description: The folder of flashbang.dll and flashbang-replay.exe. Empty: the plugin's bin folder, else this repository's build folder (nuke build flashbang).

gpu.replayDebugLayer.description: Replay with the D3D12 debug layer on, so its messages show in the capture's Messages (slower; needs Windows' Graphics Tools).

gpu.timingRepeat.description: How many times Collect Timing Data replays the frame; each event's time is the median.
